title: The saved Anam persona is thrown away on every start, forcing a slow ephemeral mint (1 RTT/118B -> up to 6 RTT/29705B)
No timeout on any Anam fetch - a slow vendor hangs /avatar/start for minutes
The 6s tokenCache does not dedupe a simultaneous double-mount; two concurrent /start calls both mint
/avatar/end is a dead stub the client calls on every close (NOT a slot leak - backend never creates an Anam session)
Base persona is fetched even when avatarId and voiceId are known, because !cfg.llmId is always true
Display-only Anam lookups run after the token is minted but before the reply is sent
listAnamResource is uncached and pages sequentially; /start can run the avatars listing twice
Four independent DB round-trips serialised in front of the Anam calls; anamKey re-reads the project row the controller just loaded
Every caption VTT of the project is read per /start (30KB-1.7MB) and discarded entirely on the stateful path
A stale or brainless saved persona costs two extra round-trips on every start forever; the config is never repaired
knowledgeToolId is a false proxy for 'the persona carries the RAG tool'; the re-bake guard skips personas with inherited avatar/voice
tokenCache is an unbounded module-level Map with no eviction
POST /api/v1/avatar/start has no body schema; a malformed projectId becomes a misleading 404
ANAM_ENV and PERSONA_MAP snapshot process.env at module load, so tests mutating ANAM_ENV exercise a different branch than production
